Scoring a Precision Kill grants 1 Stack of Magnificent Howl. Maximum of ? Stacks.

Upon finishing a reload with active Stacks:
Each shot consumes 1 Stack of Magnificent Howl, granting <pve 50% /> <pvp [?%] /> increased damage and ? Range.

(Needs verification:) Precision Kills with buffed shots don't consume Stacks.

Scoring a Precision Kill grants 1 Stack of 'Precision Final Blows' up to the maximum of 10 Stacks.

Reloading converts `Precision Final Blows` Stacks into `Magnificent Howl` Stacks.

Each shot consumes 1 Stack of Magnificent Howl, granting 50% increased damage and ?% increased Damage Falloff Distance.

Precision Kills with buffed shots don't consume Stacks.

Reloading converts `Precision Final Blows` Stacks into `Magnificent Howl` Stacks.

Each shot consumes 1 Stack of Magnificent Howl, granting 50% increased damage and ?% increased Damage Falloff Distance.

Scoring a Precision Kill grants 1 Stack of 'Precision Final Blows' up to the maximum of 10 Stacks. 

Reloading converts 'Precision Final Blows' Stacks into 'Magnificent Howl' Stacks. Having active 'Magnificent Howl' Stacks prevents you from gaining 'Precision Final Blows' Stacks.

Each shot consumes 1 Stack of Magnificent Howl, granting 50% increased damage and ?% increased Damage Falloff Distance.

Precision Kills with buffed shots refund a Stack of Magnificent Howl.
